hero.lead: Your player-built hub for Clover Legends on Roblox: working codes, every grimoire, community tier lists, and progression guides for awakening, Book Levels and the Magic Knight ranks.
hero.supportingText: Clover Legends is a Roblox Action RPG by Flecks Labs: Legends where you collect grimoires, fight through 8 islands in real-time combat, and climb 17 Magic Knight ranks. This wiki keeps the parts that change most often, like codes and rankings, checked and clearly dated.

sections.heading: Clover Legends at a Glance
paragraphs: Before you pick a grimoire or spend a reroll, it helps to know what kind of game Clover Legends actually is. The official Roblox listing describes a real-time action RPG built around spells, dodges and ultimates rather than turn-based battles. You level your character and your equipped book separately, and awakening pushes a grimoire past its normal limits.
The table below pulls together the core facts from the game's official description so you can plan a route without guessing.

Two details in that table shape almost every decision a player makes. First, grimoires are split into four availability groups, so which book you carry is largely a question of luck and reroll budget. Second, awakening depends on Spell Pages from bosses, which means the strongest upgrades in the game are gated behind deliberate boss hunts rather than passive play. Keep both in mind and the rest of the systems fall into place.

subsections.heading: What each code reward does
paragraphs: Gems are the game's main spendable currency, Race Rerolls let you redraw your character's race and its reported stat bonuses, and Spell Pages feed the awakening system that raises your book's level cap. In other words, one good code drop touches three different progression systems at once.

sections.heading: All 12 Clover Legends Grimoires
paragraphs: Every player in Clover Legends carries a grimoire, and the official Roblox description groups all 12 books into four availability tiers. You start among Fire, Wind and Water, while Light and Anti-Magic sit in the rarest group. Your book gains Book Level as you fight, and new spells unlock at Book Level 10 and Book Level 20, so even a common starter book grows with you.

sections.heading: How Progression Works
paragraphs: Clover Legends runs several progression tracks at once, and mixing them up is the most common way new players stall. Character level, Book Level, awakening and Magic Knight rank all advance on their own schedules.

subsections.heading: Book Levels and Spell Unlocks
paragraphs: Your grimoire levels while you fight, not through a separate menu grind. The two milestones that matter most are Book Level 10 and Book Level 20, because each one adds new spells to the book you already carry. That makes an early investment in any book pay off before you ever reroll.

subsections.heading: Awakening and Spell Pages
paragraphs: Awakening is the long-term upgrade system. You gather materials across the islands and hunt Spell Pages from bosses, and each awakening raises your book's level cap while improving its damage and critical performance. It is a slow burn, which is why the awakening guide walks through preparation before you spend anything.

subsections.heading: Magic Knight Ranks and Islands
paragraphs: The world spans 8 islands, and 17 Magic Knight ranks run from Junior 5th at the bottom to Grand 1st at the top. Moving to a new island usually follows the live quest route, and rank promotions track how far along that route you have come.

sections.heading: Start Here: Beginner Route
paragraphs: If you are launching Clover Legends for the first time, the route below keeps you from wasting the resources that matter early. It stays deliberately high level, because exact quest details shift with game updates.

steps.heading: Claim every working code
steps.description: Redeem the active codes before you spend Gems or rerolls, so free Race Rerolls and Spell Pages are already in your inventory.

steps.heading: Learn your starting grimoire
steps.description: Fight with the book you rolled instead of rerolling on instinct. Book Level 10 arrives quickly and unlocks new spells.

steps.heading: Practice real-time combat
steps.description: Get comfortable with combos, dodge timing and your equipped spells on early enemies before tougher islands punish sloppy play.

steps.heading: Follow the early quests
steps.description: Early quests level both your character and your grimoire at the same time, which is the most efficient use of your first hours.

steps.heading: Push toward Book Level 10 and 20
steps.description: Keep your book equipped while questing so both spell milestones unlock as early as possible.

steps.heading: Bank awakening materials
steps.description: Hold on to gathered materials and any Spell Pages from bosses. You will need them for your first awakening, and spending early makes that wait longer.

steps.heading: Move islands with the quest route
steps.description: When the live quests send you to the next island, follow them. The route is tuned to introduce new content at a survivable difficulty.

faq.question: What is Clover Legends?
faq.answer: Clover Legends is a Roblox Action RPG by Flecks Labs: Legends. You collect grimoires, fight in real-time combat with combos, dodges and ultimates, and progress through 8 islands while climbing 17 Magic Knight ranks.

faq.question: Is Clover Legends on Roblox?
faq.answer: Yes. Clover Legends is a Roblox experience, and the only official place to play it is its listing on the Roblox platform under developer Flecks Labs: Legends.

faq.question: How many grimoires are in Clover Legends?
faq.answer: There are 12 grimoires, split by the official description into four availability groups: Fire, Wind and Water as starters; Earth, Lightning, Plant, Poison and Chain next; World Tree and Dark as rarer books; and Light and Anti-Magic as the rarest.

faq.question: When do grimoires unlock new spells?
faq.answer: A grimoire gains Book Level as you fight, and new spells unlock at Book Level 10 and Book Level 20 on the book you already carry.

faq.question: How does awakening work?
faq.answer: Awakening uses materials you gather plus Spell Pages hunted from bosses. Each awakening raises your book's level cap and improves its damage and critical performance.

faq.question: Where can I find Clover Legends codes?
faq.answer: The developer shares codes through the game's official channels, with the Roblox listing pointing to its Discord as the release channel. This wiki's codes page tracks the currently working set with a last-checked date.
